verdict.rationale: Scoped, least-privilege API credentials are a fair question for a SaaS app-building platform like Figma Make, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents issuing API tokens, scopes or permission-limited credentials for agents. The docs cover chats, MCP connections to external tools, backends and sharing guidelines, none of which is credential scoping. The probes found no OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
